items.title: Sam Most interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: who was sitting in the audience right in front of us but Dizzy Gillespie and Sonny Stitt so I was a little nervous doing those jazz concerts.

ctx.x: Did you have to go down to the union and like hang out waiting for gigs or were those days gone?

Yeah that was the days when you went down to the union and said do you have Saturday? You know, I mean anything happening on Saturday? Or you’d see people that says hey you working Saturday? We got a gig for you. You know, this wedding, this bar mitzvah, this party. So there was a little coming in that way. I was doing some concerts around New York too. I haven’t thought about this for a long time, but I did some, this is just fragments of association. I did one concert with, I had a small group at Town Hall, I…
